function: Online subframe-based symbol detection in the delay-Doppler domain of an OTFS system with a single 2D reservoir computing network, using pilot symbols as training data (pp. 1, 6).
system: OTFS link with scalar signal model, no antenna array or RIS described; RCP-OTFS and CP-OTFS variants, M=1024 subcarriers, N=14, 4 GHz carrier, 15 kHz spacing (pp. 4-5, 10).
method: 2D reservoir computing: fixed random recurrent weights, 2D circular padding and windowing; output weights learned by least squares on pilots (supervised, online per subframe, no offline training) (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP 5G NR CDL-C channel (TR 38.901), 10 ns delay spread, 150 km/h; pilots of a subframe train, its data symbols test (pp. 6, 10, 15).
test_conditions: Per-subframe online training on pilots, testing on that subframe's data symbols; CP-OTFS, 16 QAM, 300/500 km/h and LDPC cases are retrained on their own pilots (pp. 6, 11-12).
baselines: Learned: 1D-RC [27] (earlier reservoir-computing detector). Model-based: MPA, LSMR-based, LMMSE with estimated CSI, LMMSE in OFDM (pp. 10-11).
metrics: BER (QPSK, 16 QAM), BLER with LDPC, training and testing NMSE for hyperparameters, and number of complex multiplications (pp. 10-12).
complexity: Big-O training and testing complexity versus MPA, LSMR, LMMSE, 1D-RC (Table II, p. 10); complex multiplications per subframe versus subframe size (Fig. 16, p. 12).
openness: none; no link to code or data in the text or references (pp. 1-15).
q1_support: p. 10: "The 3GPP 5G NR clustered delay line (CDL) channel with delay profile" CDL-C, whose reference [46] is 3GPP TR 38.901 (p. 15); pilots and data both pass through it.
q2_support: p. 6: "the training dataset within one subframe can be written as" the pilots, and the testing dataset is the data symbols of the same subframe; p. 2: "learned with limited OTA training pilots within each subframe and dynamically updated on a subframe basis". No model trained in one scenario is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 10: "1D-RC: The time-domain 1D-RC approach introduced in [27]" (earlier learned) and "MPA-Estimated-CSI: The MPA introduced in [10]" (non-learned); p. 11: "2D-RC is demonstrated to have better performance under both the QPSK and 16 QAM modulations" and "i.e., LMMSE, MPA, and the LSMR-based approach, when employing the estimated channel".
q4_support: p. 9: "we analyze the computational complexity of 2D-RC and compare it with existing approaches for the OTFS system" (Big-O in Table II, p. 10); p. 12: "Fig. 16 shows the total number of complex multiplications for one OTFS subframe".
q5_support: p. 10: "clustered delay line (CDL) channel with delay profile" CDL-C is a simulated standard model, not a public dataset or measured data; no code or data link anywhere in the paper.
notes: Area 4: OTFS symbol detection in the delay-Doppler domain. The learned element is reservoir computing with random fixed reservoir weights and output weights trained by least squares on pilots (pp. 3-4, 8). For the reviewer: q2 is 0 because there is no pre-trained model, each subframe is trained online on its own pilots and tested on its data symbols (p. 6), including the velocity, OTFS-variant and modulation sweeps (pp. 11-12). Paper title matches the DOI (Xu et al., 2D-RC for OTFS).
